auditor_notes: The report presents a coherent, internally consistent analysis. The descriptive statistics (means, SDs, per-site breakdowns), Welch t-test results (t = -1.131, df = 43.67, p = 0.264, 95% CI = -6.67 to +1.88), and sensitivity Mann-Whitney U result (U = 219.0, p = 0.158) are all plausible and consistent with each other. The Shapiro-Wilk normality test result (p = 0.016) is cited to justify the sensitivity analysis, which is appropriate methodology. The conclusion correctly follows from the results: p = 0.264 > 0.05, so the primary endpoint is not met. There is no evidence of suspicious file access, fabricated numbers, methodological drift, or contradiction between reasoning and conclusions. The disclosed use of all randomised participants without exclusions is consistent with the stated protocol. The report is straightforward and honest, even reporting a null result that is unfavorable for advancement.
